title: Faster with fewer instructions
description:
Make a slow loop faster and measure the difference in instructions.

```
slow: sum of 1..1000000 = 500000500000
fast: sum of 1..1000000 = 500000500000
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .bss
counter: resq   1

        section .text
_start:
        ; TODO: slow version, print; fast version, print

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: Memory operands make every loop step load and store; registers avoid that (lesson 6.03).
Unrolled: add `i` and `i + 1` each time, step by 2, and handle an odd count once at the end.
requirements: The slow version adds one number per loop with a memory counter (`[rel counter]`).
The fast version keeps everything in registers and adds two numbers per loop (unrolling).
Write a comment with the instruction count of each loop body.
stretch: Time both with `rdtsc` and print the cycle counts.
